control_name: ACORD forms in use are on the current release version
control_objective: Every ACORD form rendered, ingested, or filed by the organization is on the current ACORD release version so that downstream carriers, agents, and regulators receive standard-conformant document layouts.
risk_addressed: Use of superseded ACORD form versions produces non-conformant submissions that are rejected by carrier and regulator intake, delays filings, and erodes straight-through processing across the agency-carrier integration estate.

applies_to: ACORD standard forms in active production use

required_data_elements.business_definition: The ACORD form identifier and version currently published in the active forms inventory.
The latest ACORD release version for the corresponding form per the ACORD Forms Release Bulletin.

method.summary: Compare every in-use ACORD form against the current ACORD Forms Release Bulletin and flag any form on a superseded version.
steps: Enumerate all ACORD forms in the active forms inventory.
Resolve the current release version for each form from the ACORD Forms Release Bulletin.
Flag any form whose in-use version is superseded by a newer ACORD release.
Compute the percentage of forms on the latest version.
method.fallback_logic: If the forms library is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any superseded ACORD form in active use is a conformance exception.
thresholds.warning_threshold: Any form not yet on the latest release
thresholds.escalation_threshold: 1 or more superseded form versions in use

pass_criteria: No superseded ACORD form versions remain in use.
All active forms reconcile to the current ACORD release.
warning_criteria: Some forms are not yet on the latest ACORD release version.
fail_criteria: One or more superseded ACORD form versions remain in active use.
exception_handling: Retire superseded forms and republish on the current release before re-testing.

assertions.description: No superseded ACORD form versions remain in use.
All forms are on the latest ACORD release.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Must be re-evidenced each quarter before forms filings are submitted.

actions_on_fail: Notify Integration Architect and Forms Librarian
